short_videos.narration: Meet Health Metrics Tracker. See your daily wellness overview and keep the habits that matter together.
Build a better hydration routine. Log your water intake, review your goal, and celebrate every small step.
Follow your weight journey with clarity. Record your entries and see how your progress changes over time.
Make food logging part of your day. Keep a diary of meals, calories, and key nutrients in one place.
Keep your blood pressure readings organized. Add a record and revisit previous entries whenever you need them.
Explore practical wellness calculators in Health Metrics Tracker. Choose a tool and review its results in moments.
See your body mass index and its reference range. A simple way to understand one wellness measurement.
Turn recorded blood pressure readings into a visual timeline. Spot changes and review patterns over time.
Take your tracking records with you. Explore available PDF, CSV, and JSON export options inside the app.
Make Health Metrics Tracker fit your routine. Adjust preferences and choose reminders that work for you.

scenes.title: INTRODUCTION
scenes.narration: Meet Health Metrics Tracker, a simple home for your daily wellness routine.

scenes.narration: Open the dashboard to see your daily trackers and wellness overview together.

scenes.title: WATER TRACKING
scenes.narration: Log your water intake and see how you're progressing toward your daily hydration goal.

scenes.title: WEIGHT JOURNEY
scenes.narration: Record your weight, review your history, and understand changes across your journey.

scenes.title: FOOD DIARY
scenes.narration: Keep a food diary with calories and macronutrients to understand your everyday meals.

scenes.title: BLOOD PRESSURE LOG
scenes.narration: Save blood pressure readings and revisit your previous records in one organized place.

scenes.title: WELLNESS CALCULATORS
scenes.narration: Explore the available wellness calculators and choose the one that fits your needs.

scenes.title: BMI CALCULATOR
scenes.narration: Calculate your body mass index and view the reference categories alongside your result.

scenes.title: PRESSURE TRENDS
scenes.narration: Explore charts of your recorded blood pressure readings and follow changes over time.

scenes.title: WELLNESS INSIGHTS
scenes.narration: Explore wellness insights based on your check-ins and the information you've recorded.

scenes.title: CALCULATION HISTORY
scenes.narration: Go back to past calculations and revisit the results you've already saved.

scenes.title: EXPORT YOUR DATA
scenes.narration: Explore PDF, CSV, and JSON export options for the records you choose to keep.

scenes.title: SETTINGS AND REMINDERS
scenes.narration: Customize app preferences and manage reminders to make tracking work for you.

scenes.title: TRACK YOUR DAY
scenes.narration: Health Metrics Tracker. Track your day, review your progress, and stay engaged with your habits.
